title: Define observability requirements for Private backup/restore (metrics, dashboards, alerts)
creator: Rafael Mendes
description:
Goal
- Specify the metrics, dashboards, and alerting required for the Redwood Private Day-2 backup/restore toolkit so operators + SRE can detect backup regressions quickly and run restores with evidence.

Context
- We are shipping `rw-private-dr` backup/restore tooling plus Helm CronJobs/Jobs. Operators need:
  - “Is my last backup recent and valid?”
  - “Are backups failing (and why)?”
  - “How long do backups/restores take vs our maintenance window?”
  - “Did we meet our RPO/RTO targets in drills?”
- We also need to avoid alert noise (paused clusters, intentional maintenance mode, etc.).

Scope
1) Metrics emitted by backup/restore tooling (CronJob/Job) and by control plane components during maintenance mode / write quiesce.
2) Dashboards for operator/SRE views.
3) Alerts + runbook linking conventions.

Out of scope
- Building a full DR managed service. This is requirements + implementation wiring in observability-pack.

Proposed metric set (minimum)
Naming convention: `rw_private_dr_*` (Prometheus). All metrics MUST include labels:
- `cluster` (logical cluster identifier)
- `env` (prod/stage/dev where applicable)
- `deployment_mode` (vpc|onprem)
- `backup_target` (s3|minio|nfs|gcs|azure|filebundle)
- `job_type` (backup|restore|verify|prune)
Optional labels (use sparingly to control cardinality): `reason`, `result`, `phase`

Backup metrics
- `rw_private_dr_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster=...}` (gauge)
- `rw_private_dr_backup_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds{cluster=...}` (gauge)
- `rw_private_dr_backup_attempts_total{result=success|failure,reason=...}` (counter)
- `rw_private_dr_backup_duration_seconds{phase=...}` (histogram)
  - phases: preflight, db_dump, wal_archive_config_check, artifact_snapshot, upload, finalize, verify
- `rw_private_dr_backup_bytes_total` (counter) + `rw_private_dr_backup_artifacts_count` (gauge or counter per attempt)
- `rw_private_dr_backup_verify_total{result=success|failure,reason=...}` (counter)
- `rw_private_dr_backup_integrity_check_total{result=success|failure}` (counter) (checksums/manifest verification)

Restore metrics
- `rw_private_dr_restore_attempts_total{result=success|failure,reason=...}` (counter)
- `rw_private_dr_restore_duration_seconds{phase=...}` (histogram)
  - phases: preflight, maintenance_mode_enable, db_restore, wal_replay, artifact_restore, restart_control_plane, smoke_tests, maintenance_mode_disable
- `rw_private_dr_restore_validation_total{result=success|failure,check=...}` (counter)
- `rw_private_dr_restore_last_success_timestamp_seconds` (gauge)

Job health / k8s integration
- For CronJob/Job we should rely on kube-state-metrics for schedule/failed/succeeded where possible, but still emit “tooling-level” metrics above (k8s job success doesn’t necessarily mean “backup is usable”).

Control plane signals (for restore safety)
- `rw_private_maintenance_mode_state{state=enabled|disabled}` (gauge)
- `rw_private_write_quiesce_total{result=success|failure}` (counter)
These are expected from control plane instrumentation work (see references).

Dashboards (Grafana)
A) Operator dashboard: “Private Backup/Restore Overview”
- Stat panels:
  - Last successful backup age (per cluster)
  - Backup success rate (7d)
  - p50/p95 backup duration (7d)
  - Last restore drill outcome (annotation + last success timestamp)
- Time series:
  - Backup duration by phase (stacked or small multiples)
  - Backup attempts success/failure (with top failure reasons)
  - Restore attempts + duration (if any)
- Tables:
  - Clusters with stale backups (age > threshold)
  - Clusters with repeated failures (>N in window)

B) SRE dashboard: “Private DR SLO/Signals”
- Backup success objective per cluster (ties into error budget-style report; see slo-toolkit reference)
- Missed backup windows (by cluster) with suppression state
- Alert volume panel for backup/restore alerts (to validate noise)

C) Drill/incident dashboard: “Restore Drill Timeline”
- Annotate restore start/stop, maintenance mode enable/disable
- Panels for smoke test failures and API health checks

Alerting requirements
All alerts MUST include:
- cluster identifier
- last successful backup timestamp / age
- link to runbook(s)
- link to dashboard
- next-step text (actionable)

Alert 1: Missed backup window
- Condition: no successful backup within configured window + grace period.
- Default: window=24h (Standard tier), 6h (Strict tier); grace=2h.
- Noise control: if cluster is labeled `rw_private_dr_backup_paused=true` (or equivalent config), suppress.

Alert 2: Repeated backup failures
- Condition: >=3 failures in 6h OR >=5 failures in 24h.
- Include top `reason` label if present (e.g., AccessDenied, throttling, lock_contention, checksum_mismatch).

Alert 3: Backup duration regression
- Condition: p95 backup duration > (baseline * 2) for 2 consecutive windows OR exceeds operator configured maintenance window.
- Note: This is advisory (page only for Strict tier; ticket for Standard).

Alert 4: Restore validation failure (during drill or real restore)
- Condition: restore attempt result=failure OR smoke tests failing.
- Severity: page (because this likely occurs during an incident window).

Alert 5: “Last-successful backup age” high-watermark
- Condition: last_success_age > 48h (Standard) or > 12h (Strict).
- This is the “simple” catch-all (even if CronJob schedule is misconfigured).

Severity recommendations (initial)
- Strict tier: Alert 1/2/4 page; 3/5 ticket unless during active incident.
- Standard tier: Alert 1/2 ticket; 4 page; 3/5 ticket.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Metrics listed above are emitted from backup/restore jobs and visible in at least one test Private environment.
- [ ] Grafana dashboards added to observability-pack with templating by cluster/deployment_mode.
- [ ] Alerts added with runbook links and noise reduction for paused clusters.
- [ ] Dashboard + alert naming conventions reviewed by Observability Lead (Allison) and SRE (Sean/Rafael).
- [ ] Documentation updates: Confluence page for “Private backup/restore observability” reflects final metric names, alert thresholds, and runbook references.

Open questions
- Do we want separate dashboards for VPC vs on-prem, or single dashboard with filter?
- What is the official label/key for “paused cluster” to suppress alerts (installer config vs kube label)?
- Cardinality constraints for `reason` label: propose to bucket reasons into a fixed enum to avoid raw error codes.

Implementation notes
- Prefer emitting metrics from the job container via Prometheus pushgateway OR direct scraping endpoint (depends on how the job runs today). If pushgateway is used, ensure TTL cleanup so old job series don’t persist indefinitely.
- Ensure restore metrics are emitted even when restore fails early (preflight), otherwise we lose data during the most common failure mode.

comments: 2025-10-16 (Allison Grant): Please align metric naming with existing Private prefixing (`rw_private_*`) and keep label cardinality tight. Avoid `namespace`/`pod` labels unless necessary; cluster+deployment_mode should be enough for dashboards.

2025-10-22 (Rafael Mendes): In DR drill #0 we lost ~25 min just determining whether the backup we had was actually verified. Strongly prefer a first-class `backup_verify_total` metric and a dashboard panel that explicitly shows last verified backup time (not just last backup job success).

2025-11-03 (Sergio Costa): Drafted dashboard panels; need confirmation on suppression mechanism for paused clusters. Proposing `rw_private_dr_backup_paused` as a config that the job emits as a gauge=1 to allow PromQL suppression even without k8s label propagation.

2025-11-12 (Sean Gallagher): Alert thresholds: start conservative to avoid noise. For Standard tier, I’d rather ticket on stale backups (48h) than page. Paging should be reserved for repeated failures or active restore windows. Also ensure alerts include last-successful timestamp (operators always ask for that).
2025-11-20 (Diego Santos): For on-prem/air-gapped, ensure dashboards don’t assume cloud-provider labels. `backup_target=filebundle` should be supported and shown as a first-class filter option.

2025-12-02 (Sergio Costa): Implemented dashboards + alerts in observability-pack PRs. Remaining: confirm Prometheus integration approach for Jobs in Private default install and update Confluence metric list to reflect final names.

2025-12-05 (Allison Grant): Reviewed PR_229/PR_237—LGTM on structure. Requested minor changes: rename `rw_private_dr_backup_bytes_total` -> `rw_private_dr_backup_upload_bytes_total` to avoid ambiguity; add annotation guidance for drills (how to tag restore drills so we can trend RTO).
